decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (DP/1568/RG/01, 02 and 03, Carbon Filter Maintenance Schedule, Carbon Filter details, Silencer details, Axial Fans details, Design and Access Statement all received 12/01/2011 ) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The proposed replacement extract flue as shown on drawing DP/1568/RG/02 received on 12/01/2011 shall be fully installed (including the silencer and carbon filter unit) and the existing extract flue shall be fully removed within three months of the date of this permission unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [1100-2400 Mondays to Saturdays and 1100-2300 on Sundays and Bank Holidays].

Condition : 4 - Within three months of the date of this permission a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house 2 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins shall be identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.
description: Retrospective application for the change of  use of the premises to a hot food takeaway (Use Class A5) and erection of a ventilation duct on the rear elevation.
